exposure: Inter-pregnancy interval (IPI) following a medically treated missed abortion
outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth (PTB) <37 weeks of gestation
cohort: The study included 1,110 patients with a history of a missed abortion treated with misoprostol only, followed by a documented live pregnancy between 2010 and 2022.
finding: Short IPI (<=18 months) following a medical treatment for missed abortion was associated with an increased risk of PTB, Cesarean delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
